description: Utilities class for working with configuration within the Orleans runtime, including parsing TimeSpan strings, resolving IP addresses, obtaining local IP addresses, and redacting sensitive information in connection strings.

classes.name: ConfigUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for processing configuration data, resolving IP addresses, and handling connection strings within the Orleans runtime environment.

methods.name: ParseTimeSpan
methods.description: Parses a string representing a time span with optional units ('ms', 's', 'm', 'hr') into a TimeSpan object.

methods.name: ResolveIPAddressOrDefault
methods.description: Resolves an IPAddress based on network interfaces, a hostname or address string, and optional subnet and address family filtering.

methods.name: GetLocalIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local server's IP address for a specified address family, optionally filtered by interface name.

methods.name: RedactConnectionStringInfo
methods.description: Returns a version of the provided connection string with sensitive credential information redacted.
